header: THE DATABASE SIDE OF AN ANNOUNCEMENT'S PDF (the table public.announcement_file, src/lib/nl2sql/sql/28_announcement_file.sql). I wrap every READ here in a savepoint, so that a database where the table has not been created yet (the SQL file not run, and nobody has attached a PDF) simply has no files, and the announcements themselves are untouched. Postgres aborts a whole transaction at the first failed statement; the savepoint is what keeps one missing table from taking the list of announcements down with it.

symbols.name: StoredFile
doc: A file as the database holds it. Use `url` on the server only.

symbols.name: tryInSavepoint
symbols.sig: export async function tryInSavepoint<T>(q: QueryFn, fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T | null>
doc: I run `fn` so that its failure leaves the transaction usable; it returns what `fn` returned, or `null` if it failed.

symbols.name: ensureFileTable
symbols.sig: export async function ensureFileTable(q: QueryFn): Promise<void>
doc: Creates the table if it is not there (the first PDF ever attached). If the database user is not allowed to, I let the error go up and the route says to run the SQL file.

symbols.name: fileOf
symbols.sig: export async function fileOf(q: QueryFn, id: number): Promise<StoredFile | null>
doc: Returns the file of one announcement, address included, or null (none, or no table yet).

symbols.name: filesOf
symbols.sig: export async function filesOf(q: QueryFn, ids: number[]): Promise<Map<number, AnnouncementFileInfo>>
doc: Returns the name and size of the files of these announcements, by announcement id. I never return the address here.

symbols.name: saveFile
symbols.sig: export async function saveFile(q: QueryFn, id: number, f: StoredFile, ticket: string): Promise<void>
doc: I save the file of an announcement here, replacing the one it had.

symbols.name: dropFile
symbols.sig: export async function dropFile(q: QueryFn, id: number): Promise<void>
doc: Removes the row of an announcement's file. The PDF in Blob is deleted by the caller, after the commit, not here.
